name: group-by-clause-test-38c059a6f0/group-by-list-ctr-v.bal
spec_references: Expressions — Query expressions: "Supports `group by` and `collect` clauses"; "Supports `list` and `map` as `query-constructor-type`"

Subset restrictions / Import declarations: "Only following lang libraries with given methods/types are supported"; `ballerina/lang.int` lists `Signed8`, `Signed16`, `Signed32`, `Unsigned8`, `Unsigned16`, `Unsigned32`, `toHexString`, `fromString`, `fromHexString` (no `sum`).
reason: Although group-by list/map queries are supported, this whole case requires unsupported query result constructors and integer aggregation. Executed stream-output tests consume grouped streams with next() and assert [[11,15],[10,9,13],[30]]; table-output tests assert keyed grouped table results. Both stream and table query constructors fall outside the positive list. getTotal calls int:sum to determine asserted filtering results, and nested grouping queries also call int:sum, absent from the supported integer langlib list.
unsupported_constructs: `stream from ... group by ... select ...` query constructor and stream consumption
`table key(...) from ... group by ... select ...` query constructor
test_design_notes: The main function invokes the stream/table and aggregation-dependent tests; these are asserted behaviors, not unused signatures.
Group-by support alone does not cover the whole case; io:println instrumentation does not determine classification.
